gaps.what: End of the state: 1293 is Cliopatria's year; the pages give disintegration after 1025, last epigraphic mention 1030-1031, Jambi leading from the 11th century, Palembang taken 1288 and again 1377

The 718 gain (Isthmus of Kra) and the 1139 losses (Kedah and the strip north of it) rest on Cliopatria's years at confidence 1; the sibling dossier tambralinga.json (from the Tambralinga page) has Srivijaya occupying Tambralinga 775-969 and Tambralinga independent 970-1277
Mandala vassals and Sailendra rule over Java, the Ligor inscription of c. 775, and the Jambi capital shift are not drawn; Kedah, Tambralinga, Langkasuka pages not opened
Shapes 825, 896 and 1028 (Sunda alone or with Galuh) carry no dated page; the Galuh page puts the absorption in the 10th century
Whether coastal Banten and Jakarta were Srivijayan after the invasion (Tarumanagara page) and whether Sunda was Majapahit's vassal after Bubat 1357 ('possible' on the Bubat page)
Galuh's extent in 612-669, its capital years (Saunggalah undated) and the 825-895, 1028-1474 gaps in Cliopatria; the Galuh king list stops at 799
End 669 (infobox) against c. 686 (Kota Kapur reading in the text); no extent for Suryawarman's 535 shape; no reign dates (Wangsakerta rulers not used)
The Sailendra dynasty of Central Java (c. 775-852) is not a Cliopatria row and was not opened; the extent of Mataram before Balitung (898) is the page's description only; Wurawari date 1006 or 1016

Bali's status under Mataram, Kahuripan and Kediri (ally, vassal, colony) and the date Bali regained independence after Singhasari (1293 is a bridge); the reason for Cliopatria's split at 1333; no ruler dates

problems: All six states in the owned table are written and validate with 0 errors; Srivijaya shows 4 warnings only for counterpart slugs with no dossier yet (kantoli, melayu-kingdom twice, langkasuka). No region name is unresolved and every region resolves to a non-empty set of cells.

Cliopatria rows split or merged: none. Sunda Kingdom, Galuh Kingdom and Srivijaya are each kept as one state; the Sunda row's 26,774 / 62,041 km2 alternation is Sunda alone versus Sunda plus Galuh, and its 724-740 shapes (62,498 and 121,225 km2) are corrected to Sunda alone because they swallow Galuh and Sanjaya's Mataram.

Early Balinese Kingdoms shares Wikipedia 'Bali Kingdom' and Q12491027 with balinese-kingdom (se-02-e) and 'Bali' (1687-1907). I wrote early-balinese-kingdoms alone (infobox 914-1343, sovereign), not a merged dossier, because Bali is a Majapahit vassal 1343-1478 and Cliopatria has no shape for it; se-02-e must not assume the merge. Colour agent: same family (southeast-asia), decide on one hue. Majapahit's dossier should carry Bali from 1343.

Sibling conflict: tambralinga.json (se-01-x) has Srivijaya occupying the Isthmus of Kra 775-969, against Cliopatria's Srivijaya shape holding it until 1138; my 718 and 1139 events are Cliopatria's years at confidence 1 and a reviewer should prefer the Tambralinga page.
Srivijaya ends in 1293 (Cliopatria's year, confidence 1); the pages point to c. 1025-1031, 1288 or 1377. Reviewer's call.

The 669/670 separation of Galuh and Sunda from Tarumanagara is carried as a pair across three dossiers (Tarumanagara vassal_start 612 / vassal_end 669 / dissolve 669, Galuh found 612 / gain 669, Sunda found 670); the dependency reading 612-669 is mine (confidence 2).

WebFetch answers through a summariser, so quoted phrases are its rendering of the page; two URLs (Singhasari_Empire, Sumedang_Larang) were not found and were recovered at Singhasari and Sumedang_Larang_Kingdom.

Page budgets: Srivijaya 5/5, Sunda 9/9, Galuh 5/5, Tarumanagara 5/5, Early Balinese 5/5; Mataram cites 5 pages against a budget of 1-2 because three (Galuh, Airlangga, Srivijaya) were opened for the neighbours. 20 distinct pages in all.
